notes.title: Personal Trainer 1.1.3 Beta
notes.content:
Personal Trainer 1.1.3 is live on the beta build. This is a small update that addresses critical bugs with Maria and Dani storylines. Players who were locked out of completing Maria's story should now be able to continue it on their current save game even if they've already completed all of the other characters content.

To enter the beta, right click on Personal Trainer in your Steam Library and select properties. This should bring up the following window, allowing you to enter the beta. There is no code required so you can leave it blank.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44199047/57e58e0b77d88e4b30b2269b4cc7bfca9191b876.jpg[/img]

Once it's clear that this build is working as intended, I'll push it to the main branch.

Thank you all for your support,
Dom

notes.title: Personal Trainer 1.1.2 is now available!
notes.content:
It's been a long journey, and now it feels surreal to see Personal Trainer on Steam. I'm relieved, scared, excited, nervous—I think I have butterflies in my stomach! It feels like I'm kissing a girl for the very first time again. No, I wasn't awkward, why do you ask?

I can't wait to hear your thoughts and experiences. I hope you all enjoy the game and remember that it doesn't take itself seriously and neither should you! Err, I mean, you can take yourself seriously just don't take the game ser- eh, nevermind

Cheers!
Dom

notes.title: Personal Trainer Beta is Underway!
notes.content:
The game is now in beta and undergoing testing with a larger player base. I want to allow ample time for bugs to be reported so that I can assess how long it will take to fix and finalize the release build. The official Steam release date will be announced soon.

Thank you all for your patience!
